payload.title: Avoid repeated configuration loading during portfolio assessment
payload.description:
Account-wide portfolio dogfooding showed severe repeated configuration and scorecard lookup work during per-score assessment. The run makes progress, but hundreds of candidates create a long operator wait and noisy logs because shared account/scorecard/configuration context appears to be reloaded repeatedly. Keep this performance work separate from automatic-execution semantics.

Feature: Efficient exhaustive portfolio assessment

Scenario: Reuse frozen portfolio context
  Given exhaustive ranking has frozen the account inventory and evidence window
  When every ranked score is assessed
  Then shared account, scorecard, and configuration context is reused safely
  And the run does not reload identical configuration once per score
  And every score remains assessed with complete coverage

Scenario: Report measurable progress
  Given a large exhaustive portfolio assessment is running
  When assessment advances
  Then aggregate progress and timing are visible to operators
  And logs avoid repeated opaque-identifier and configuration-load noise

Observed sanitized evidence: the first durable ranking milestone required many minutes; a subsequent exhaustive assessment contained hundreds of candidates and repeatedly emitted configuration-load and scorecard-lookup messages. No client identity or score data is recorded here.

Out of scope for the current automatic-mode change: changing ranking metrics, sampling the portfolio, or weakening exhaustive coverage.
